def _get_item_length(item, parents_ids=frozenset([])):
    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
        length = 0
        item_id = id(item)
        if item_id in parents_ids:
            return 0
        parents_ids = add_to_frozen_set(parents_ids, item_id)
        for k, v in item.items():
            length += 1
            length += _get_item_length(v, parents_ids)
        return length
    elif isinstance(item, strings):
        return 1
    elif isinstance(item, Iterable):
        length = 0
        item_id = id(item)
        if item_id in parents_ids:
            return 0
        parents_ids = add_to_frozen_set(parents_ids, item_id)
        for i in item:
            length += 1
            length += _get_item_length(i, parents_ids)
        return length
    else:
        return 1

def _get_numbers_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if num1 == num2:
        return 0
    if use_log_scale:
        num1 = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num1) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num1)
        num2 = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num2) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num2)
    divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_
    if divisor == 0:
        return max_
    result = abs((num1 - num2) / divisor)
    distance = min(result, max_)
    if use_log_scale and distance < log_scale_similarity_threshold:
        return 0
    return distance

def _get_rough_distance(self):
    _distance = get_numeric_types_distance(
        self.t1, self.t2, max_=self.cutoff_distance_for_pairs, use_log_scale=self.use_log_scale, log_scale_similarity_threshold=self.log_scale_similarity_threshold)

    if _distance is not not_found:
        return _distance

    if not hasattr(self, 'hashes'):
        raise RuntimeError(DISTANCE_CALCS_NEEDS_CACHE)

    item = self if self.view == DELTA_VIEW else self._to_delta_dict(report_repetition_required=False)
    diff_length = _get_item_length(item)

    if diff_length == 0:
        return 0

    t1_len = self.__get_item_rough_length(self.t1)
    t2_len = self.__get_item_rough_length(self.t2)

    return diff_length / (t1_len + t2_len)
